title: Color / UI palette — CMYK specifications

location.series: IBM Design Language / alternate tab states
location.label: CMYK

slide_intent: Carry a functional color subset into process-color production deliberately, because relying on visual copying can blur distinctions between structural and status colors.
strategic_value: Documented CMYK builds can help printed IBM interface illustrations stay consistent with the named UI palette.
demonstration: The CMYK table shows blue and gray ramps alongside four alert colors, each with a process-ink specification.
practical_value: Use the selected UI color’s recorded build for process-print representations while preserving the original role distinctions.

content_islands.name: Encoding selector
content_islands.spec: Keep CMYK selected above the table.

content_islands.name: Core ramps
content_islands.spec: Present the long blue and gray columns with four-channel values from black through white.

content_islands.name: Status builds
content_islands.spec: Place the shorter red, green, orange and yellow alert column to the right.

reference_purposes.Expression: The blue, gray and alert grouping shows the structure of IBM’s UI subset.
reference_purposes.Application: Each UI swatch carries a CMYK build, including Alert 40 c 0 m 60 y 91 k 0 and Alert 30 c 6 m 22 y 99 k 0.
